title: Family Favorites (Canceled)
shortDescription: The original Family Favorites trivia is canceled. Four Dogs will instead host Home for the Holidays on Tuesday, November 24 at 7 PM.
description: The previously listed Family Favorites Tuesday trivia game at WesCo Brew & Bowl on November 24 is canceled. However, Four Dogs will now host a separate Home for the Holidays: Thanksgiving Week Game Night on Tuesday, November 24, starting at approximately 7 PM. See the Home for the Holidays event listing for its current details.
instructions: Family Favorites trivia is canceled, but a separate Home for the Holidays game night is planned for Tuesday, November 24 at 7:00 PM. Check the Home for the Holidays event page for updates before heading out.
